group_event_reward_amounts.name: group_event_reward_amounts
group_event_reward_amounts.value: "group_event_rewards"."xp" >= 0 AND "group_event_rewards"."xp" = CAST("group_event_rewards"."xp" AS INTEGER) AND "group_event_rewards"."points" >= 0 AND "group_event_rewards"."points" = CAST("group_event_rewards"."points" AS INTEGER) AND "group_event_rewards"."coins" >= 0 AND "group_event_rewards"."coins" = CAST("group_event_rewards"."coins" AS INTEGER)

group_event_run_numbers.name: group_event_run_numbers
group_event_run_numbers.value: "group_event_runs"."wave_number" >= 1 AND "group_event_runs"."wave_number" = CAST("group_event_runs"."wave_number" AS INTEGER) AND "group_event_runs"."round_number" >= 1 AND "group_event_runs"."round_number" = CAST("group_event_runs"."round_number" AS INTEGER) AND "group_event_runs"."state_version" >= 0 AND "group_event_runs"."state_version" = CAST("group_event_runs"."state_version" AS INTEGER)

inventory_weapon_instance.name: inventory_weapon_instance
inventory_weapon_instance.value: "inventory_items"."weapon_level" IS NULL OR ("inventory_items"."quantity" = 1 AND "inventory_items"."weapon_level" >= 1 AND "inventory_items"."weapon_level" = CAST("inventory_items"."weapon_level" AS INTEGER))
